mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.store_id, l.seller_sku, l.platform_item_id, l.parent_item_id, l.platform_extra, l.material_id, l.pack_qty, l.compose_type, l.last_pushed_qty FROM ecom_listing l WHERE l.store_id = #{storeId} AND l.fulfillment = 'SELLER' AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.stock_locked = 0 AND (l.material_id IS NOT NULL OR (l.compose_type = 'BUNDLE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_bundle_item b WHERE b.listing_id = l.id))) ORDER BY l.id
SELECT store_id, sync_type, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM ecom_sync_log WHERE success = 0 AND start_time >= #{since} GROUP BY store_id, sync_type
